Carrie is back with a brand-new modern adaptation from Mike Flanagan, and this series does a lot more than simply retell Stephen King’s original story. We explain the ending, Emaline and her mother, the people hunting Carrie, and what all of this could mean for a potential Season 2. We’re also diving into Carrie’s connection to the Shine, how the series expands Stephen King’s larger interconnected universe, and why the organization hunting Carrie could potentially be The Shop.
